pages.text: The roof of the mosque stood on trunks of palm trees, and when the Prophet ﷺ gave a sermon, he would stand by one of those trunks.
A woman of the Ansar, or a man, said: “O Messenger of Allah, shall we not make a minbar for you?” He said: “If you wish.” (Sahih al-Bukhari 3584)
So they made a minbar for him. When Friday came and he ﷺ moved to the minbar, the trunk cried out like a little child.
The Prophet ﷺ came down and held it close to him, and it moaned like a little child being hushed; and he said: “It was crying for the remembrance it used to hear near it.” (Sahih al-Bukhari 3584)
